| communication | Make setup guidance actionable | partial | 5/7 | The [Install Sepo and Quick guide links](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/8bba644849ed56dfc1e0e795729d8447b062ff5a/README.md#L5-L9) resolve successfully, but the README no longer distinguishes starting from the template from installing into an existing repository. The template-ownership guidance moved to [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/8bba644849ed56dfc1e0e795729d8447b062ff5a/AGENTS.md#L14), outside the primary human entry page. |
| coding_workflow | Keep docs in sync | pass | 7/7 | The rename is consistently reflected in the [update workflow](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/8bba644849ed56dfc1e0e795729d8447b062ff5a/.github/workflows/agent-update.yml#L23-L27), install/update prompts, and skills; the head tree has no stale `AGENT.md` content references. |
| coding_workflow | Make surgical changes | pass | 8/8 | The 34-addition/39-deletion diff stays focused: README framing plus the canonical `AGENTS.md` rename, required reference updates, and a `CLAUDE.md` symlink. No adjacent refactoring appears. |

## Notes

- The primary score reduction is the communication regression relative to the lean front-door design established in [PR #464](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/464): the direct two-path get-started guidance was removed while conceptual framing became denser.
- The exact head (`8bba644`) passes `git diff --check` and the full `.agent` `test:ci` suite. All five newly introduced public URLs returned HTTP 200. The live GitHub check was still pending during review.
- Smallest useful follow-up: shorten the opening to one plain value sentence and restore one compact line distinguishing “new repository from template” from “install into an existing repository,” with direct links.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** The README only partially satisfies the audience-first and actionable-setup rubrics: its action row is strong, but the prose front-loads product vision and internal persistence concepts while hiding the template-user next step in agent-facing guidance.
- **INFO:** The `AGENTS.md` migration itself is focused and internally consistent across the changed workflow, prompts, and skills.

## Final Rubric Verdict

PARTIAL

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue

PR #476 reframes the README around Sepo’s three-stage landing-page narrative and updates its primary links. It also renames `AGENT.md` to `AGENTS.md`, adds a `CLAUDE.md` bridge, and propagates the rename through install/update prompts, skills, and workflow text. The goal is a single canonical agent-guidance file and a leaner project entrance. The rename is consistent, but the Claude bridge and downstream installation contract are incomplete.

## Review

The current head passes all reported checks and has no blocking defects. Two concrete portability and rollout gaps merit branch changes, while the README concern is a non-blocking product-copy judgment.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Portable Claude bridge | WARNING | The `CLAUDE.md` symlink becomes an inert plain file in non-symlink checkouts, including common Windows configurations. |
| Complete downstream guidance rollout | WARNING | Existing-repository installs omit the Claude bridge, while updates lack an ownership-safe migration from previously installed `AGENT.md` files. |
| Reader-first README entry | WARNING | The lead repeats the following numbered structure and removes the compact distinction between template and existing-repository setup paths. |

## Progress

- The `AGENT.md` → `AGENTS.md` reference sweep is consistent, all new public links resolve, and the current head passes `git diff --check`, the reported runtime/workflow/docs/shell suites, and GitHub’s Test Scripts check.
- The README concern is already acknowledged in the existing rubric-review comment, so no duplicate inline comment was posted.
- Posted inline comments for the [portable bridge](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/476#discussion_r3568319491), [install bundle](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/476#discussion_r3568319557), and [update migration](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/476#discussion_r3568319613).
- No prior inline comments or threads required replies, minimization, or resolution.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Portable Claude bridge</summary>

**Cause:** [`CLAUDE.md`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/3fd7bd485e52a690ac205881dc71dc9565583412/CLAUDE.md#L1) is a symlink. Git materializes symlinks as files containing the link text when `core.symlinks=false`, while [Claude’s documentation](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory#agentsmd) recommends an `@AGENTS.md` import on Windows.

**Candidate solutions:** Replace the symlink with a regular `CLAUDE.md` containing `@AGENTS.md`.

**Comments:** One reviewer considered this low-risk INFO because Unix checkouts work; another rated it WARNING. The synthesis uses WARNING because this is a template repository and the regular import has no corresponding portability drawback.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Complete downstream guidance rollout</summary>

**Cause:** The [install allowlist](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/3fd7bd485e52a690ac205881dc71dc9565583412/.github/prompts/agent-install.md#L66) copies only `AGENTS.md`. The [update contract](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/3fd7bd485e52a690ac205881dc71dc9565583412/.github/prompts/agent-update.md#L31) checks the new name while legacy removal remains disabled, so existing `AGENT.md` installations can be skipped or left stale.

**Candidate solutions:** Treat `AGENTS.md` and a non-conflicting `CLAUDE.md` import as one guarded optional bundle. Audit and rename singular guidance only when identical, clearly Sepo-owned, or explicitly approved; preserve divergent files and mirror the contract in prompts, skills, workflow text, validation, and staging.

**Comments:** Reviewers disagreed about blast radius, but the gap is concrete whenever optional root guidance was previously installed.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Reader-first README entry</summary>

**Cause:** The opening sentence pre-enumerates the same three stages immediately repeated below, while the prior direct template-versus-existing-repository start line was removed.

**Candidate solutions:** Shorten the lead to one plain value sentence and restore one compact line linking both setup paths.

**Comments:** Claude and the rubric review flagged this; Codex considered the README sound. This remains maintainer judgment and is intentionally excluded from automated action items.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step

`FIX_PR`: The two technical warnings are bounded branch changes suitable for automation; the README wording can remain a maintainer decision.

## Final Verdict

`MINOR_ISSUES`

## Action Items

- [ ] Replace the `CLAUDE.md` symlink with a portable `@AGENTS.md` import.
- [ ] Make `AGENTS.md` plus `CLAUDE.md` a guarded install/update bundle and add an ownership-safe `AGENT.md` migration path.

---
`codex` | `gpt-5.6-sol[max]` | `Macmini-runner-6`
